goal.current_capability: No executable task create/complete workflow exists.
goal.required_capability: A user can create a task and mark it complete through the application.

fixed_interfaces: Task identity and completion state remain explicit product concepts.
allowed_interface_evolution: Private implementation details may change inside the campaign.
state_semantics: Task completion must be persisted consistently if persistence is introduced.
protected_boundaries: CLIENT product requirements may not be redefined by implementation.

charter_invalidation_events: CLIENT changes the required task workflow materially.
Live evidence shows the selected capability boundary is incompatible with the target architecture.
done_when: Task creation and completion work end-to-end on the exact candidate.
Independent review is bound to the exact candidate.
The product is ready for the applicable product/human gate.
